note: Routes drawn by Claude; move devices only. The run to the trunk shares the ECU harness's RH sill run (Dan Y5 a); the pump feed and the pump ground go round the inside of the trunk (RH side, back panel) and share the short leg forward to the pump; pump ground on factory point BL, back panel centre (1993 EWD p.234, p.46). The back panel run sits inside the back wall (Dan Z5 a, 2026-11-11: corridor 8 back line at x -3135). The fuel level sender is on AB-cabin (Dan N1 a). Relay block, battery and kill switch on Dan's heavy cable editor save (Z4 b, 2026-11-11 21:58; R2: the relay block just right of the battery, about 8 in forward of the trunk's back wall; X5 rule); the pump feed runs back from the relay block along the trunk's RH side. Main trunks redrawn into the approved wireway corridors (Dan 2026-11-11 12:19, DECISIONS B8 "Wireway corridors", corridors.json); device spots unchanged.
